# Dependabot holds the Skills workflow refs three days after every release

## Context

The operator's question on #20612 (2026-11-08): if Dependabot moves `package.json` and the lockfile but not the workflow refs, every Skills release needs a manual PR, and that isn't worth it. Measured: Dependabot does move the fixed `@vX.Y.Z` refs, and auto-merge lands them with no human. `pr-baseline.yml` was moved six times since 10-30, and `pr-review.yml` and `dependabot-automerge.yml` were moved in #20610. But every move arrives three days after the release.

## The Problem

`.github/dependabot.yml`'s npm entry exempts `neo-agent-skills` from Dependabot's default cooldown (#19392). Its `github-actions` entry configures none. So the default hold applies to the Skills workflow refs: 3 days, "even when `cooldown` is not configured" ([GitHub Docs](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/reference/supply-chain-security/dependabot-options-reference)).

On 2026-11-08, every consumer's `actions` update moved the refs to `v0.1.90` (released 11-05). All four skipped `v0.1.91` through `v1.2.0`, which were each under three days old: Engine #20610, Brain #1522, Institution #893 and devindex #125. In the same runs, the cooldown-exempt npm updates took `1.1.0` and `1.2.0`. A release-age hold explains the skip; a "never crosses a major" rule doesn't, because that rule would have picked `v0.1.98`.

The cost: a PR that needs a new Skills workflow input the same day hand-moves the ref, as #20598 did (`guards`) and #20612 does (`guides`).

## The Architectural Reality

- `.github/dependabot.yml`, `github-actions` entry: a daily cron (#20606), one `actions` group, no `cooldown`.
- Dependabot names these dependencies `neomjs/neo-agent-skills/.github/workflows/<file>.yml`, as #20610's body lists them. `cooldown.exclude` supports `*`, and `github-actions` supports `default-days` (GitHub Docs).
- The callers are `pr-baseline.yml`, `pr-review.yml` and `dependabot-automerge.yml`. The last one hands each Dependabot PR to auto-merge, which merges it once `dev`'s required checks pass.

## The Fix

Give the `github-actions` entry the npm entry's cooldown, with the npm entry's reason:

```yaml
    cooldown:
      default-days: 3
      exclude: ["neomjs/neo-agent-skills*"]
```

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: the `github-actions` entry exempts the Skills workflows from the cooldown, and every other actions dependency keeps the 3-day hold (the diff).
- [ ] AC-2 (post-merge): the next Dependabot `actions` run proposes the newest Skills release for every Skills workflow ref. The config change itself triggers that run, which should move `pr-review.yml` and `dependabot-automerge.yml` from `v0.1.90` to the newest `v1.x`.

## Out of Scope

- The Brain, the Institution and devindex. Each needs the same one-entry change in its own repository.
- The npm pin, already exempt (#19392), and a moving `@latest` tag, which the operator rejected on 2026-09-25 (neomjs/neo-agent-skills#114).
